verdict.rationale: Extend documents a full public REST API with authentication, SDKs, CLI, and API quickstart, and runtime probes confirm the API is live and cleanly auth-gated (returns proper UNAUTHORIZED errors on unauth requests) with a working CLI installable from npm. This is strong first-party plus hands-on confirmation of programmatic, documented API access suited to AI-native driving of the product. missing for 10: independent third-party developer accounts of building against the API beyond the vendor/probe evidence.
